hotels.title: Romantic Vineyard Retreat near Brisbane with Glamping-Style Pavilions & Daily Breakfast
hotels.description: Indulge your senses and inner wine connoisseur with a winery stay at this tranquil bushland haven. With superbly appointed tented pavilions, this unique addition to the family-owned Sirromet Winery is ideally located for those looking to leave the hustle and bustle behind and reconnect with nature. Wandering kangaroos, singing kookaburras, alfresco dining and waking up amid 560 acres of native bushland are just some of the attractions that await for a romantic, wine-fuelled stay. Set around a natural lagoon fringed with gum trees, this boutique property invites you to roam through nature with a glass of top-notch vino in hand. Spend your days exploring lush grounds and nearby vineyards, dining on Italian-inspired fare at the Tuscan Terrace and sampling award-winning Granite Belt wines from Cellar Door. End your day in your private pavilion with breathtaking views from your balcony.

hotels.title: Tranquil Vineyard Glamping Retreat near Brisbane with Cellar Door
hotels.description: Indulge your senses and reconnect with nature during a stay amid the tranquility of the Australian bush at Sanctuary by Sirromet on Mount Cotton, where you’ll find luxurious tented suites and pavilions located on the grounds of Sirromet Winery. Stamped with a Tripadvisor Travellers’ Choice 2021 award, Sanctuary by Sirromet offers high-class amenities, award-winning wines and a peaceful setting. Spend balmy evenings on your private deck overlooking the sparkling laguna, with the serene silence only interrupted by the rustling of the trees, scampering local fauna and the clink of wine glasses as you toast to your escape. The best part? You’re perfectly positioned on a luscious vineyard for a tipple of award-winning Granite Belt wine. When you're not savouring the fruits of the land, the two onsite restaurants will take your tastebuds on a culinary journey.
